technique_name: Describe the main theme of the given book.
description: The main theme of John Steinbeck's Of Mice and Men is the struggle of individuals to gain unconditional acceptance in a harsh world. Set during the Great Depression, the novel follows George and Lennie, two migrant farm workers, as they search for work and strive to find a sense of home and family among the dusty fields of California.
